To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

ARCIMBOLDOLITE can be used to solve structures with 40 to 120 amino acids and resolution of 1.5 Å or better on a single workstation, and that the performance of the single workstation implementation is very similar to that of the grid version.
ARCIMBOLDOLITE solves the phase problem for proteins of around 120 amino acids and up to 2.2 Å resolution using a single workstation.

ARCIMBOLDOLITE is a useful program for solving small structures on a single workstation and that the combination of ARCIMBOLDOMOD and ARCIMBOLDOSHREDDER is a useful tool for solving structures with 40 to 120 amino acids in the absence of a grid.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of methods to solve the phase problem in the 2-4 Å resolution range.
the development of a software package for solving protein structures at resolutions of 2.2-2.4 Å, which is a typical limit in the current phase of the protein X-ray structure determination process.
the development of methods and software for solving the phase problem in macromolecular crystallography.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, for the structures studied, ARCIMBOLDOShredder is a better choice than ARCIMBOLDOLite, and that ARCIMBOLDOBorges is the most efficient choice.
ARCIMBOLDOM, in its various implementations and parameterizations, is the best method for the solution of protein structures at low resolutions.

the use of the ARCIMBOLDOLITE program is highly recommended in all cases where the structure of a protein can be determined to a resolution of 1.5 Å or better, and where the structure contains no more than about 200 amino acids.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ARCIMBOLDA is a powerful and robust program for solving protein structures at high resolution.
the use of a single workstation is possible for the solution of structures with 40 amino acids and resolutions better than 0.8 Å.

The main takeaway from our work is that
ARCIMBOLDOM_LITE is a powerful and robust program to solve small protein structures, even when the resolution is below 1.5 Å.
ARCIMBOLDOLITE can successfully solve small structures in a reasonable amount of time on a single workstation.
, for structures with 40 to 120 residues, the single-workstation version can solve the structure of proteins in a reasonable time, even with the default parameters.
